description: Returns a fact summary of a Base token: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, proxy/upgradeable status, owner and whether ownership is renounced, which risky functions exist in the contract code (mint, pause, blacklist, fee setters, ownership transfer), and the token's deepest DEX pools on Base (Uniswap v2/v3, Aerodrome) with reserves, USD price and liquidity. Fields: ok, token, abilities, market.deepest_pool, market.pools, risk_flags, grade (A-F), summary, warnings, checked_at, block. Grade rule: starts at 100; each risk flag subtracts points (mint, pause, blacklist, proxy, privileged owner -25; fee setters, owner transfer -10; under $10,000 liquidity -20; no liquidity -40); renounced owner adds 10. A 85+, B 70+, C 55+, D 40+, F below. Stablecoins like USDC are upgradeable by their issuer, so they lose points. Data summary from on-chain code and pool reserves, not financial advice. Base only. Input: ?address=0x... (token contract). Cached 60 seconds. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; a
name: token-check
